stories.title: ‘No retreat’: Key Trump ally urges continued US-China engagement on rare earths

en.title: 'No retreat': Key Trump ally urges continued US-China engagement on rare earths
en.summary: US Senator Steve Daines, a Trump associate and Washington-Beijing intermediary, has called for sustained dialogue between the United States and China on rare earth supply chains and other outstanding issues despite recent differences.

stories.title: US man arrested over alleged $300 million scheme to smuggle Nvidia AI servers to China

en.title: US man arrested over alleged $300 million scheme to smuggle Nvidia AI servers to China
en.summary: California technology company owner Greg Lui was arrested and charged with violating US export controls by allegedly using Malaysia and Singapore as transit points to send over $300 million in restricted computer servers to China.

stories.title: Brazil’s Lula hails ‘bold’ Chinese investors as rival pitches rare earths to Trump

en.title: Brazil's Lula hails 'bold' Chinese investors as rival pitches rare earths to Trump
en.summary: Brazilian President Lula da Silva identified China as a potential partner for developing critical minerals domestically rather than exporting raw materials, ahead of an upcoming election.

stories.title: Panama auditor targets ex-port regulators and CK Hutchison’s executives in canal probe

en.title: Panama auditor targets ex-port regulators and CK Hutchison's executives in canal probe
en.summary: Panama's comptroller general announced plans to send prosecutors additional audit materials concerning CK Hutchison executives as part of a criminal investigation into the Hong Kong conglomerate's cancelled Panama Canal ports concession.

stories.title: Taiwan coastguard uses water cannons to warn off mainland Chinese fishing vessel

en.title: Taiwan coastguard uses water cannons to warn off mainland Chinese fishing vessel
en.summary: Taiwan's Coast Guard Administration used water cannons to expel a mainland Chinese fishing vessel near Dongsha Island in the South China Sea on October 1, located 27 nautical miles east of the Taiwanese-controlled island.

stories.title: King Charles to acknowledge ‘darkest days’ of colonial rule on Caribbean tour

en.title: King Charles to acknowledge 'darkest days' of colonial rule on Caribbean tour
en.summary: King Charles will visit Caribbean nations including the Bahamas, Guyana, and Antigua and Barbuda this month, during which he plans to acknowledge the colonial period and slavery while addressing Commonwealth leaders.

stories.title: New York governor attacks handling of Cornell gang rape case, appoints special prosecutor

en.title: New York governor attacks handling of Cornell gang rape case, appoints special prosecutor
en.summary: New York Governor Kathy Hochul criticized police and prosecutors for inadequately investigating an alleged 2024 gang rape at Cornell University and appointed the state Attorney General as special prosecutor to examine the allegations.

stories.title: Off-duty senior ambulanceman dies after abseiling fall on Kowloon Peak

en.title: Off-duty senior ambulanceman dies after abseiling fall on Kowloon Peak
en.summary: An off-duty senior ambulanceman died after falling from a cliff while abseiling on Kowloon Peak in Hong Kong. Rescue teams recovered an unconscious man at a nearby cliff and also found another man with minor injuries.

stories.title: （爱知·名古屋亚运会）综合消息：中国“金花”包揽网球女单冠亚军 中国女足无缘领奖台

en.title: (Aichi Nagoya Asian Games) Roundup: Chinese players sweep tennis women's singles medals; Chinese women's football team misses podium
en.summary: At the Aichi Nagoya Asian Games, Wang Xiyu defeated Zhang Shuai 2-0 to win the women's tennis singles title, with China claiming gold and silver medals and achieving six consecutive titles. China's women's football team finished fourth after losing 0-1 to South Korea in the bronze medal match.

stories.title: 泰国洪灾形势有所缓解 政府要求防范新一轮降雨

en.title: Thailand's flooding situation eases as government prepares for new rainfall
en.summary: Thailand's prime minister stated that government departments should prepare for potentially heavier rainfall beginning October 5, with particular attention to the southern region.

stories.title: 七国集团就推动主要炼油国家增产增加柴油供应达成一致

en.title: Group of Seven reaches consensus on promoting major oil-refining nations to increase diesel supply
en.summary: Leaders of the Group of Seven held a video conference on October 2 to address surging oil prices and energy supply pressures, agreeing on coordinated actions to stabilize markets, ease burdens on households and businesses, and strengthen long-term energy system resilience.

stories.title: 2 Hongkongers held in Philippines for months after prison terms end

en.title: 2 Hongkongers held in Philippines for months after prison terms end
en.summary: Two Hong Kong residents remain detained in the Philippines for months after completing their prison sentences. The Chinese embassy in Manila has raised concerns about their cases with Philippine authorities.

stories.title: McDonald’s sells Hong Kong shop for US$15.3 million as ‘old money’ returns to retail

en.title: McDonald's sells Hong Kong shop for US$15.3 million as 'old money' returns to retail
en.summary: McDonald's has sold a Hong Kong property housing its first New Territories restaurant for HK$120 million to Keen Charm Holdings, continuing its year-long divestment of self-owned locations as traditional wealth re-enters the retail property market.

stories.title: Clara Chan retains helm at HKIC as HK$62b state fund aligns with city’s 5-year plan

en.title: Clara Chan retains helm at HKIC as HK$62b state fund aligns with city's 5-year plan
en.summary: Hong Kong Investment Corporation's CEO Clara Chan has been reappointed for three additional years through October 2029, as the government-backed fund managing HK$62 billion supports emerging industries aligned with the city's five-year development strategy.

stories.title: Developers vie to land plum HK$2 billion residential site in Ho Man Tin

en.title: Developers vie to land plum HK$2 billion residential site in Ho Man Tin
en.summary: Ten developers submitted bids for Hong Kong's sole residential site in the latest government land sale programme before Friday's deadline. Major firms including Chinachem Group, Wheelock Properties, Kerry Properties and Sun Hung Kai Properties competed for the Fat Kwong Street site in Ho Man Tin.

stories.title: Hong Kong IPOs falter, China aids homebuyers, EU trade talks

en.title: Hong Kong IPOs falter, China aids homebuyers, EU trade talks
en.summary: Hong Kong's initial public offerings are struggling as investor appetite weakens relative to supply. Seven of twelve September debuts fell on their first trading day, with fifteen flops recorded in the third quarter compared to fourteen declines in the first half of the year.

stories.title: China’s AI compute ambitions demand innovation

en.title: China's AI compute ambitions demand innovation
en.summary: China aims to expand its intelligent computing capacity more than fourfold by 2030 to advance artificial intelligence development. Achieving this target while facing US restrictions on importing advanced Western AI chips will require significant innovation and resource coordination.
